banknote.title: Your number travels the world. You don't have to.
banknote.body:
Take a banknote out of your wallet. Any one. Before you spend it, write six small characters on it: rotabo — plus the Rotabo number you get when you register: rotabo2244. Then let it go.

Tomorrow it pays for someone's coffee. Next week it's change in a taxi three cities away. Next month it crosses a border in a stranger's pocket. Money never stops moving — and now, neither does your name.

Somewhere, someone looks down at the note in their hand. They see it: rotabo2244. Curiosity does the rest. They type it into rotabo.app — and there you are. Your name. Your flag. What you offer. A real person, findable by anyone, anywhere, who ever holds that piece of paper.

No billboard travels this far. No ad lives this long. A banknote stays in circulation for years, passing through hundreds of hands — and every single one of them can find you. One pen. One number. The whole world becomes your advertisement.
banknote.fineprint: Writing on banknotes is your own choice. Check your local laws.

bridge.title: The Bridge — a translator when you need one, for life as an immigrant
bridge.body: You're far from home, in a country whose language you barely grasp, and every official letter tightens your stomach. At the counter, at the doctor's, at your child's school, or on the phone with some agency — you don't need a translator all the time, just exactly when it matters. I come with you wherever you need me and translate on the spot, so you understand what's happening and what you have to do. I break official letters down into plain words: what it is, by when, where to sign. I make the calls for you and speak the local language, while you sit beside me at ease. We fill out the applications together, step by step, at the right office. I don't just translate the language — I translate peace of mind, and I hold your hand until you get where you need to be. From “I don't understand” to “I've got this.”

recruit.title: Rotabo is looking for drivers. Everywhere.
recruit.lead: We're starting a worldwide search for people who want to drive so that someone else doesn't have to.
recruit.req: You don't need a car. You don't need a company. You need a valid licence, a clear head, and a reason to show up.

how.title: How it works
how.body: Someone lists themselves as looking for a driver in your city. You see their name and phone number. You call the ones you want. You drive their car, with them in it, and they get home safe.

where.title: Where
where.body: Anywhere. Rotabo is live in 38 languages from day one. If nobody drives in your city yet, be the first — early drivers get every request that comes in.

safety.h2: Drivers who drive for a reason
safety.check1: Every driver joins to keep someone off the road who shouldn't be on it
safety.check2: Identity and licence confirmed before the first journey
safety.check3: A shared code of conduct, agreed by everyone who drives
safety.check4: Share your live journey with anyone you choose
safety.check5: Rate every driver, report any incident

partners_card.p: Let your guests enjoy the evening and still drive home in their own car. Offer Rotabo at the table, at reception, or at the door.

investors_card.p: Rotabo connects people across 12 categories in 38 languages, worldwide — no commission taken from anyone who offers their time, skills, or equipment. We're talking to people who back that model.

drivers_card.p: Every journey you take is one nobody takes badly. Choose your own hours, drive cars you never have to own, and get people home the way they wanted to go.

supporters.p: Rotabo is kept going by anyone willing to stand behind the idea that nobody should drive when they shouldn't.
supporters.invite: We especially welcome banks, insurers, sports brands, energy-drink and soft-drink makers — and any business that stands behind sober driving.
